summary: Core AI Holdings filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the expansion of its strategic TikTok partnership to strengthen global distribution infrastructure. The filing describes growth in user acquisition across casual games, a second traffic source, and utility applications, but does not involve any transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The press release is routine business development and forward-looking statements. No specific deal terms, stakeholders, premiums, or dates are provided.
